responsibility: This Modula-2 definition module exposes the foreign interface to the pretty-printing and dump-file management services implemented in m2pp.cc. It declares procedures to create and close gm2 gimple dump files and to dump a GCC tree/function declaration to a file descriptor, so Modula-2-side code can trigger IR diagnostics without containing any of the underlying tree traversal or formatting logic.
same_name_distinction: Modula-2 definition-module view of m2pp: unlike m2pp.h, which is the native C/C++ header with the dump-kind enum, gated pretty-print entry point, and GDB helpers, and unlike m2pp.cc, which implements the printer, this .def file only declares the Modula-2 foreign-callable dump-file and file-descriptor procedures.
